notes: Curated library of ROUVY routes and structured workouts referenced by the Tulsa Tough block. Routes already named in training-plan.json carry used_in_plan_days. ftp_range_w is an athlete-fit hint based on Chris's current 232 W FTP, not a hard limit. No ROUVY API exists yet — these are curated matches for the Suggest tab.

routes.name: 36 KM Nordlolland Denmark
routes.notes: Flat Danish coastal road. Workhorse route for steady Z2, fueling rehearsals, pace-partner drafting practice. Low cognitive load.

routes.name: Ironman World Championship Kona
routes.notes: Full IM bike leg. Day 1 benchmark and Day 10 mid-block long ride. Direct comparison is the point.

routes.name: Stelvio Pass
routes.notes: 48 switchbacks. Sustained 7-9% gradient. Mental durability simulator.

routes.name: Alpe d'Huez
routes.notes: Iconic 21-corner climb. ~50-min FTP test substitute.

routes.name: Mont Ventoux from Bedoin
routes.notes: Forest then lunar moonscape. Heat and wind on the top half — heat-tolerance proxy for Tulsa June weather.

routes.name: Col du Tourmalet
routes.notes: Pyrenean classic. Steady high-tempo grind.

routes.name: Col du Galibier
routes.notes: High alpine, thin-air feel.

routes.name: Sa Calobra Mallorca
routes.notes: Tight switchbacks, ~7% average. Hard 30-40 min efforts.

routes.name: Passo del Mortirolo
routes.notes: 10.5% average. Brutal sustained effort. Save for late-block test.

routes.name: Passo Pordoi
routes.notes: Dolomite classic, steady gradient.

routes.name: Strade Bianche Tuscany
routes.notes: White-gravel sectors. Punchy, broken rhythm — peloton-surge proxy.

routes.name: Paris-Roubaix Cobble Sectors
routes.notes: Flat with chaotic cobble surges. Excellent surge/recovery practice for Tulsa peloton dynamics.

routes.name: Tour of Flanders
routes.notes: Repeated short steep walls. Direct repeatability training.

routes.name: Liege-Bastogne-Liege
routes.notes: The Doyenne. Endless rolling Ardennes. Big aerobic stress.

routes.name: UCI Worlds Imola Circuit
routes.notes: Repeatable punchy circuit. Race-sim laps.

routes.name: Box Hill UK
routes.notes: Short repeatable climb. VO2 hill repeats in a fixed time window.

routes.name: Ditchling Beacon
routes.notes: South Downs wall. 5-7 min all-out efforts.

routes.name: Lake Como Bellagio Loop
routes.notes: Rolling lakeside, varied rhythm. Z2-tempo mix.

routes.name: Gran Canaria Volcano Loop
routes.notes: Long sustained climb on a hot island. Race-day-heat proxy.

routes.name: Saalbach Valley Flow
routes.notes: True easy spin route for taper and recovery days.

routes.name: Maratona dles Dolomites
routes.notes: Seven Dolomite passes. Outsized long day.

routes.name: Cape Epic Stage Prologue
routes.notes: MTB crossover toward EHOTS Rio Grande Valley July 5.

routes.name: Hartlepool to Whitby Coast
routes.notes: Steady coastal rollers. Alternate to Nordlolland when you want a rhythm change.

routes.name: Girona Costa Brava Loop
routes.notes: Pro training ground. Long Z2-tempo blocks fit naturally.

routes.name: Tour Down Under Corkscrew
routes.notes: Adelaide Hills rhythm. Punchy finish climb.

workouts.name: High Cadence Drills | Start Easy
workouts.structure: Progressive cadence ramps from 85 RPM to 110+ RPM, 2-3 min on / 1 min off.
workouts.notes: Day 1 PM. Established Chris's natural 61 RPM and proven 111 RPM ceiling.

workouts.name: FTP Builder
workouts.structure: 4x8 min @ 95-100% FTP, 4 min recovery between.
workouts.notes: Plan default for threshold builds. Day 8 extends to 5x8. ERG OFF — Tulsa requires self-paced.

workouts.name: Sweet Spot Builder
workouts.structure: 3x12 min @ 88-92% FTP inside a Z2 base ride.
workouts.notes: Highest ROI zone for fondo. Stretchable to 2-3 hr with the same blocks inside.

workouts.name: VO2 Max Microbursts
workouts.structure: 40s @ 120% FTP / 20s easy. 2-3 sets of 10 reps. 8 min between sets.
workouts.notes: Peloton surge / corner-exit simulator. Day 16 is the taper sharpener — keep total hard time near 20 min.

workouts.name: Puncheur
workouts.structure: 30s @ 130% FTP / 30s float at 60% FTP. 3 sets of 8 reps.
workouts.notes: Fixed-gear attack instincts apply directly. Float means keep the legs spinning.

workouts.name: Sustained Power Build
workouts.structure: 2x20 min @ 88-92% FTP. 10 min between.
workouts.notes: Longest sustained effort of the block. The work that lets you survive Tulsa hour 4.

workouts.name: Ramp Test
workouts.structure: Warm-up then +20 W per minute until failure. ROUVY estimates FTP at 75% of 1-min peak.
workouts.notes: Quick FTP recheck. Use mid-block only if a planned threshold workout feels mis-calibrated.

workouts.name: Recovery Spin
workouts.structure: Easy Z1, free cadence. No structure.
workouts.notes: If HR creeps above 130, slow down.

workouts.name: Endurance Foundation 90
workouts.structure: Strict Z2 with 3x5 min steady tempo blocks at 80% FTP.
workouts.notes: Consolidation ride alternative to a long route.

workouts.name: Tempo Builder
workouts.structure: 3x15 min @ 80-85% FTP, 5 min recovery.
workouts.notes: Bridge between Z2 and sweet spot. Useful when sweet spot is too costly.

workouts.name: Over-Unders
workouts.structure: 3x10 min alternating 90% / 105% FTP each minute.
workouts.notes: Teaches lactate clearance under sustained load. Direct peloton surge analog.

workouts.name: 30/30 VO2
workouts.structure: 30s @ 115-120% FTP / 30s easy. 2 sets of 12 reps, 8 min between.
workouts.notes: Cleaner alternative to Puncheur when neuromuscular load needs to stay lower.

workouts.name: Anaerobic 1-min Repeats
workouts.structure: 6x1 min all-out, 4 min recovery between.
workouts.notes: Targets 1-min PR (Chris's PR is 362 W). Use sparingly.

workouts.name: Sweet Spot 2x20
workouts.structure: 2x20 min @ 90% FTP, 10 min recovery.
workouts.notes: Bigger sweet-spot dose than the 3x12 builder.

workouts.name: Cadence Pyramids
workouts.structure: Ladders 80 -> 90 -> 100 -> 110 -> 100 -> 90 RPM, 2 min each, repeat 2-3 times.
workouts.notes: Direct counter to Chris's 61 RPM natural cadence drift.

workouts.name: Race Simulation Surges
workouts.structure: Z2 base with random surges: 6-10x 30-60s @ 110-130% FTP at unpredictable spacing.
workouts.notes: Trains response to attacks you cannot pre-plan. Peloton dynamics in a single workout.

workouts.name: Tabata Block
workouts.structure: 20s all-out / 10s easy x 8. 2-3 sets, 5 min between.
workouts.notes: Off-block sharpener. Not in current plan.

workouts.name: Pre-Race Shake-Out
workouts.structure: 10 min Z1 + 3x1 min @ race pace + 5 min Z1.
workouts.notes: Day 19 / Day 20 template.

workouts.name: Fueling Rehearsal Z2
workouts.structure: Strict Z2. Eat exactly the planned race-day fueling protocol. Track every gram.
workouts.notes: Day 14 fueling dress rehearsal slot.

workouts.name: Hill Repeats VO2
workouts.structure: 5-8x 3 min @ 110-115% FTP, 3 min recovery. Pair with a punchy route.
workouts.notes: Classic VO2 dose. Box Hill or Ditchling fit.

workouts.name: Threshold 3x12
workouts.structure: 3x12 min @ 95% FTP, 6 min recovery.
workouts.notes: Mid-volume threshold dose between FTP Builder and Sustained Power Build.

workouts.name: Z2 Foundation Long
workouts.structure: 3 hr strict Z2. Cap HR at 150. No accidental tempo.
workouts.notes: Pure aerobic load. Day 4 long-form alternative when Sweet Spot Builder feels too costly.

workouts.name: Stability Score Test Spin
workouts.structure: 10 min easy + 10 min @ 150 W steady + 5 min easy. Watch HR response.
workouts.notes: If HR sits 10+ bpm above expected at 150 W, log a yellow stability flag for the day.
